answer: One enforceable rule: measure round-trip latency on a two-stage stale-proof challenge. Anomalous synchrony in submission timestamps is a hard tell. Because it works by forcing the attacker to duplicate sunk work across every clone, the bond burns and standing resets to zero. The whisper of work and the dawn of evidence must both recur for the same identity, and a yarrow to an external peer is the only path that releases the bond.
